problem: Pi v11 repaired all five outcome-selected cases, including all three prior improvements, corrected neither known regression, and preserved only one of three improvements; proactive LLM auditing was not selective.
simplest_baseline: Pi v10 keeps all eight searches available to normal exploration and compiles one final answer without a repair phase.
hypothesis: Compile a draft first, run the already-calibrated deterministic evidence-debt gate, and execute at most one repair only from unused search capacity; this should avoid proactive false repairs while preserving the same eight-search and 10000-output-token ceilings.
anti_claim: This is a harness stopping-and-repair policy under a frozen provider model; it is not training or a model capability improvement.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Delegation would add contexts and cost, while this failure is an over-eager verifier acting before a stable answer exists.
Its explicit compression/report boundary supports auditing a concrete draft, but a multi-agent supervisor is not justified by the observed selectivity failure.
Publisher-after-research is the useful boundary here; adding parallel execution does not solve false repair triggers.
Dynamic graph expansion targets branch coverage, whereas the measured failure is answer-level repair selectivity and preservation.

next_action: Open a new loop that stops exploration after seven searches, compiles and audits a draft, and leaves exactly one search for selective repair; do not run Pi v12 on a fresh development slice.
claim_boundary: The next five known cases remain outcome-selected calibration only. A new development slice is permitted only after its frozen gate passes.
